assumptions_challenged: The current submission contains characterized Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) reports and certificates.
Validated orthogonal QC assays for intact EV identity/purity (with reported LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) are available and documented.
A stability‑indicating potency assay, validated and correlated to an in vivo PD endpoint, has been developed and documented.
Reproducible release, stability, and potency have been demonstrated across ≥3 GMP‑like batches with comparability data.
Formulation and delivery device compatibility have been demonstrated with intact‑EV recovery ex vivo and appropriate in vivo controls.
falsification_conditions: Provide MCB and WCB characterization reports and CoAs showing identity, sterility/Mycoplasma/endotoxin status, and stability-relevant properties.

Deliver validated orthogonal QC assay reports (particle count, protein/lipid markers, EM, orthogonal purity assays) including fit‑for‑purpose validation data: LLOQ/ULOQ, specificity, intra/inter‑assay precision, accuracy, and method limitations.
Provide validation reports for intact‑EV recovery after formulation and device handling (recovery %, precision) and demonstration of assay suitability for formulated product.
Provide a validated, stability‑indicating potency assay with data linking the assay readout to a defined in vivo PD endpoint (dose–response and correlation analysis).
Supply manufacturing reports for ≥3 representative GMP‑like production runs with release results, yield, impurity profile, potency and stability data and formal lot‑to‑lot comparability analysis.

Present ex vivo and in vivo formulation/device compatibility studies with intact‑EV‑specific readouts and appropriate negative/vehicle controls that demonstrate preserved identity/potency after dose administration.
strongest_objection: The program proposes to advance SGL-001 into cross‑species PK/PD and lot‑comparison studies without providing any program‑specific CMC and analytical validation artifacts; the MISEV2023 guidance cited supports requiring those artifacts but does not itself demonstrate that SGL‑001 meets them. Advancement therefore risks attributing in vivo signals to ill‑defined material and uncontrolled lot variability.
